draft.body:
Thank you for reaching out about the embedded SDE opening. I am Justin Mascarenhas, and I recently finished my M.S. in Computer Engineering at RIT. Embedded systems is exactly the direction I am aiming for, so this caught my eye right away, and I am applying through the link you shared.

The skills you listed line up closely with what I have been building. I wrote a custom real time operating system on an ARM Cortex M board starting at the bare metal level, and I built a from scratch C++ inference engine that runs on embedded Linux. Between those two I have spent serious hands on time in C++, RTOS scheduling and internals, and the Linux and kernel side of things.

For context, I am on OPT and will eventually need sponsorship, so I want to make sure I land with an embedded team that can work with that. Would you be open to a short call so you can point me toward the right opening?
draft.hook_used: Recruiter named C++/RTOS/kernel/Linux as mandatory; reply maps each skill to a real project
